summary: Colville National Forest lookout site in Pend Oreille County: a 30-foot wooden L-4 tower built in 1937, now gone, with its exact location still unconfirmed.

notes_for_editor: The 1937 build and the gone status agree across all four sources. The exact site is unconfirmed: WillhiteWeb has not visited and places it on uncertain bumps west of the summit. No staffing, fire or access evidence turned up in two searches. Height 9.1 m is converted from the 30-foot figure.
